g.text: Variatio 1. a 1 Clav. — Jánko Two-Row Equator Grand Staff Prototype (mm. 1–2)
• Above Equator Line: Odds {1, 3, 5, 7, 9, b} (Upper Rank)
• Below Equator Line: Evens {0, 2, 4, 6, 8, a} (Lower Rank)

Engraving Invariants: (1) Notes never intersect lines — equator line acts purely as boundary between Evens (below) and Odds (above). (2) True Grand Staff: Left Hand and Right Hand have independent staves. (3) Stems with cuts encode duration cleanly in monochrome without hold lines.
